name: IBM Cloud Global Catalog
summary: IBM Cloud's catalog of services, plans and deployments with their public pricing, from the Global Catalog API.
notes: This entry sends no credentials: getting an entry, its children and its pricing work unauthenticated for publicly available services. Private or account-scoped entries need an IAM token, which this entry does not mint.
Entries form a tree: services have child plans, and plans have child deployments. Walk down with entry.children and price a plan with pricing.get or pricing.deployments.
include=_ (or complete=true) returns every property; by default only basic properties come back. include=metadata.pricing narrows to pricing metadata.

endpoints.name: Search catalog entries
endpoints.summary: Catalog entries matching keywords and filters.

q.description: Keywords matching name, display name or description, plus filters such as kind:, tag:, rc:true|false, iam:true|false, active:true|false, geo:, price:.

include.description: '_' for every property, or a colon-separated list such as metadata.ui:metadata.pricing.

languages.description: Language codes such as en-us, or * for all.

complete.description: true for all fields in all languages.

_offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item.

notes: The docs say permissions determine what this call shows, and do not say it works without a token; expect only public entries, or a refusal, unauthenticated.

endpoints.name: Get a catalog entry
endpoints.summary: One service, plan or deployment entry by id.

include.description: '_' for every property, or a colon-separated list of metadata fields.

languages.description: Language codes such as en-us, or * for all.

complete.description: true for all fields in all languages.

depth.description: Depth of child entries to include.

endpoints.name: List an entry's children of one kind
endpoints.summary: Child entries of a kind (e.g. the plans of a service, the deployments of a plan).

include.description: '*' for every property, or a colon-separated list of metadata fields.

descending.description: true to sort descending (offset form only).

languages.description: Language codes such as en-us, or * for all.

complete.description: true for all fields in all languages.

_offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (offset form only).

notes: When children exceed the allowed total, page with the token form (start) instead of _offset; q, sort-by and descending do not work in token form.

endpoints.name: Get pricing of an entry
endpoints.summary: Pricing of a plan or deployment entry.

deployment_region.description: For a global deployment, one region from the answer's deployment_regions list.

endpoints.name: Get pricing of a plan's deployments
endpoints.summary: One pricing per visible child deployment of a plan.
